title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single loop. This loop includes an arc starting at coordinates (0.0, 0.0013) and ending at (0.0013, 0.0) with a midpoint at (0.0004, 0.0004). Follow this with a line from (0.0013, 0.0) to (0.0065, 0.0). Next, add another arc from (0.0065, 0.0) to (0.0078, 0.0013) with a midpoint at (0.0074, 0.0004). Continue with a line from (0.0078, 0.0013) to (0.0078, 0.0365). Add a third arc from (0.0078, 0.0365) to (0.0065, 0.0378) with a midpoint at (0.0074, 0.0374). Draw a line from (0.0065, 0.0378) to (0.0013, 0.0378). Finally, include an arc from (0.0013, 0.0378) to (0.0, 0.0365) with a midpoint at (0.0004, 0.0374), and close the loop with a line from (0.0, 0.0365) to (0.0, 0.0013). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0378. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body with the extruded shape. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object with a rectangular section at the top are 0.0078125 units in length, 0.0377604 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = (
    r
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0013)
    .threePointArc((0.0004, 0.0004), (0.0013, 0.0))
    .lineTo(0.0065, 0.0)
    .threePointArc((0.0074, 0.0004), (0.0078, 0.0013))
    .lineTo(0.0078, 0.0365)
    .threePointArc((0.0074, 0.0374), (0.0065, 0.0378))
    .lineTo(0.0013, 0.0378)
    .threePointArc((0.0004, 0.0374), (0.0, 0.0365))
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0013)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0378, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0378, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0078)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)
